source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Your **HERETIC ASTARTES** models do not have [Dark Pacts](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts), and their ranged weapons get **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)**.

You cannot use [Cults of the Dark Gods](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.cults-of-the-dark-gods) when you [muster your army](vsdata:core-rule/muster-armies).

**Vendetta**: as [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, pick an enemy unit to be your Vendetta target until your next Command phase. Whenever a **HERETIC ASTARTES** model of yours (not a **DAMNED** model) attacks your Vendetta target, that model can re-roll its [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls).

**Twisted Doctrine**: whenever you set up a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit of yours (not a [Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) unit), or pick one to move, in [your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), it can Default to Doctrine, taking a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) first, after which you pick one of these:

- the unit can still shoot and still declare a charge after [Falling Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back), for the rest of the turn
- the unit can still declare a charge after [Advancing](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), for the rest of the turn

vendetta.expires: start of next own Command phase
